name: Umami
description: Umami is a simple, fast, privacy-respecting alternative to Google Analytics. It tracks page views, events, and visitor data with a small footprint, supports multiple websites, and can be self-hosted with just Node.js and a database. No cookies are required, which keeps it GDPR-friendly out of the box.
highlights: Runs on Node.js plus Postgres or MySQL
curatorNote: Umami is the analytics layer that respects visitors. The dashboard is clean, the footprint is small, and it slots into any self-hosted stack without friction.
